question: According to Census of India 2011, what was the sex ratio recorded in the Union Territory of Puducherry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1037 females/1000 males**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the Census of India 2011, the sex ratio in the Union Territory of Puducherry was **1037 females per 1000 males**.
 
• This sex ratio indicates a higher number of females compared to males in Puducherry.
